content.body:
By accessing or using the WrapGo platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or

WrapGo provides a bridge between advertisers and drivers. Our service allows for the tracking of vehicle advertisements and facilitates payments between parties.

title: User Conduct
content.body:
As a condition of use, you promise not to use the Services for any purpose that is prohibited by these Terms of Service. You are responsible for all of your activity in connection with the Services.

You shall not use the platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose.

Drivers must maintain valid insurance and registration as required by local laws.

Advertisers must provide truthful and non-misleading marketing materials.

Interference with the tracking technology is strictly prohibited.

title: Platform Usage
content.body:
WrapGo grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, and revocable license to use our platform strictly in accordance with these terms. We reserve the right to modify or terminate the platform at any time without notice.

Our platform utilizes GPS tracking via our mobile application to verify campaign impressions. By using the service as a driver, you consent to this data collection during active campaign hours.

You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from any part of our service without express written permission.
